decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Before the development commences details of parking (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the spaces shown on the approved drawing shall be available for use before the park is available for use and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.
Condition : 4 - The maximum height of trees or any foliage within the development should be 13 metres above ground level.

Condition : 5 - A Landscape Management Plan, including long term design objectives, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and BAA prior to work commencing. The Landscape Management Plan shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 6 - The site shall be investigated for ground conditions, pollution, stability, landfill gas and leachate/ground water content/regime in accordance with the scooping report submitted to the Local Planning Authority in the Derek Horne & Associates letter DHA/99/15/NG dated 16 December 2002 and shall be implemented prior to the planting of trees or landscaping works commence.

Condition : 7 - The site investigation shall be undertaken to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of all results, assessments and measures needed to render the development safe in consequence, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the planting or landscaping works commence.

Condition : 8 - Surface water drainage works shall be carried out in accordance with details, which shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before development commences.
Condition : 9 - The width of the access road should be a minimum of 4.8m wide and it is preferred that the width be 5.5m.

Condition : 10 - Before the development commences a Public Access Scheme setting out arrangements for access to the land by members of the public, including defined access points and for those points to link up with public footpaths and the highway shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 11 - Before the development commences a Management and Maintenance scheme setting out the management and maintenance of the land, including a grassed wildflower meadow, surrounding all boundaries with a mixed hedge of indigenous species with indigenous trees set out in small clumps in a parkland style shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning authority and BAA.
description: Change of use to a Country Park.
